public class ProfileActivity extends androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
Activity that displays and manages the user's profile information.

This screen allows the user to view and edit their profile details, update notification preferences, save profile changes, delete their profile, and navigate to other sections of the app using the bottom navigation bar.

    • deleteProfile

      private void deleteProfile(android.app.Dialog dialog, android.widget.Button stayButton, android.widget.Button confirmDeleteButton)
      Deletes the current user's profile after confirmation from the dialog.

      While deletion is in progress, the dialog buttons are disabled. On success, the user is returned to the splash screen. On failure, the dialog remains open and an error message is shown.

      Parameters:
      dialog - the confirmation dialog being displayed
      stayButton - the button used to cancel deletion
      confirmDeleteButton - the button used to confirm deletion
